conformer_generation.note: Molecules with >100 atoms skipped conformer generation (use 2D fallback)

3d_conformer_features.bond_length: Added to edge features - captures actual inter-atomic distances
3d_conformer_features.3d_distance: Added to edge features - captures spatial proximity
3d_conformer_features.global_features: 12 features from conformer statistics (bond length stats, angle stats, dihedral stats, volume estimate, etc.)

key_findings: 3D features improved single model RMSE by 6.4% (39.21 -> 36.71)
Global geometric features provide complementary information to 2D graph features
Gated fusion of structural + geometric features enables effective feature combination
Only 21% of molecules had successful conformer generation due to trimer size > 100 atoms
Even partial 3D feature coverage provides significant improvement
